summary: Ran shared regression verification with new follow-up coverage (legacy weights/labour, 10k catalog benchmark, PDF authoring gates, private source preview). Full shared suite rerun with routed-browser tests reproduced one authenticated admin UI failure after selector update.

critical.issue: During authenticated admin routed-browser flow, saving edited ProductFields title consistently returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT and blocks expected UI title update assertion.
Corrupt PNG path can raise unhandled SyntaxError (500) instead of mapped 422 INVALID_IMAGE because SyntaxError is not caught in image_bytes().

ui_bugs.issue: After switching authenticated UI test to labelled ProductFields input, save action fails due backend 409; corrected title never appears in UI.

integration_issues.flow: Admin login -> Panel -> Products -> PDF import -> Edit row -> Save corrected fields
integration_issues.issue: PATCH conflict interrupts reviewed PDF correction flow in routed-browser journey.

action_items: Fix PDF reviewed-row correction conflict path so admin ProductFields save succeeds reliably in routed-browser flow.
Handle PNG parser SyntaxError in upload_image validation and map to 422 INVALID_IMAGE.
Re-run full 31 shared tests (including 4 routed-browser journeys) after fix to confirm zero failures.
Review /opt/plugins-venv dependency drift if using that runtime for Playwright pytest execution.
critical_code_review_comments: image_bytes() catches UnidentifiedImageError/OSError but not SyntaxError from PIL PNG verify path, allowing 500 leakage.
PDF review save path appears version-sensitive under active UI polling; conflict handling/reload UX likely needs stabilization.
Catalog pagination behavior stayed deterministic under 10k synthetic records with capped limit=100 and no random page-1 drift in catalog mode.

success_rate.backend: 94% (34 passed / 36 executed incl. one known routed-browser failure path + one environment AutoReconnect occurrence)
success_rate.frontend: 75% (3/4 routed-browser journeys passed in Playwright-enabled run; preview load sanity passed)

seed_data_creation: Created only synthetic isolated_db records (10k metadata products, temporary slabs/users/import jobs/media assets) and wrote benchmark artifact; no production DB mutation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth/SMS/storage in tests are fixture-backed and MOCKED (MSG91 transport + object storage). Root venv run passes API suites; Playwright-enabled /opt/plugins-venv run reproduces admin PDF correction conflict. 10k catalog benchmark artifact saved for evidence.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction (admin routed-browser): login via OTP -> panel products -> pdf import sample -> edit first row title using labelled ProductFields input -> save. Observed PATCH /api/pdf-upload/{jid}/rows/{rid} returns 409 before title update is reflected, causing assertion timeout. Probable stale row version or race in reviewed-row correction lifecycle under periodic status polling. Also observed separate backend RCA: corrupt PNG during upload triggers PIL SyntaxError uncaught by image_bytes exception mapping, returning 500 instead of controlled 422.
